Merge pull request #53 from craigpastro/add-wait-safe-method

Add WaitAndRecover method to WaitGroup

pr.title: Add WaitAndRecover method to WaitGroup
pr.body:
Resolves #29.

👋 My attempt at resolving #29. I wasn't sure if was better to reimplement `Wait` in terms of `WaitSafe`. I think leaving the code as it looks a bit cleaner, so I just left it.

I also wondered if it is better to say in the docs that `WaitSafe` will return the first panic it encounters and add a test for that. That is true, right?

Thank you!

linkedIssues.title: Add a `Wait()`-like method that returns a caught panic
linkedIssues.body:
Re-panicking is not ideal for every situation. Sometimes, in the case of a panic, a user will want to handle the panic manually. It's possible to `recover()` the propagated panic, but that's extra work for the user and you lose the type information that the panic value is a `RecoveredPanic`.  

We should add a method like `WaitSafe()` that returns a `*RecoveredPanic` if a panic was caught. 

Open questions:
- What to call it? `WaitSafe`, `SafeWait`, `WaitAndRecover` all come to mind
- Do we add this just to `WaitGroup`, or also add it to each of the `.*Pool` types?

diff:
diff --git a/waitgroup.go b/waitgroup.go
index 214cd85..6fc1627 100644
--- a/waitgroup.go
+++ b/waitgroup.go
@@ -41,3 +41,12 @@ func (h *WaitGroup) Wait() {
 	// Propagate a panic if we caught one from a child goroutine.
 	h.pc.Repanic()
 }
+
+// WaitAndRecover will block until all goroutines spawned with Go exit and
+// will return a *panics.RecoveredPanic if one of the child goroutines panics.
+func (h *WaitGroup) WaitAndRecover() *panics.RecoveredPanic {
+	h.wg.Wait()
+
+	// Return a recovered panic if we caught one from a child goroutine.
+	return h.pc.Recovered()
+}
diff --git a/waitgroup_test.go b/waitgroup_test.go
index 74e1dfd..331cff5 100644
--- a/waitgroup_test.go
+++ b/waitgroup_test.go
@@ -98,5 +98,46 @@ func TestWaitGroup(t *testing.T) {
 			require.Panics(t, wg.Wait)
 			require.Equal(t, int64(2), i.Load())
 		})
+
+		t.Run("is caught by waitandrecover", func(t *testing.T) {
+			t.Parallel()
+			var wg WaitGroup
+			wg.Go(func() {
+				panic("super bad thing")
+			})
+			p := wg.WaitAndRecover()
+			require.Equal(t, p.Value, "super bad thing")
+		})
+
+		t.Run("one is caught by waitandrecover", func(t *testing.T) {
+			t.Parallel()
+			var wg WaitGroup
+			wg.Go(func() {
+				panic("super bad thing")
+			})
+			wg.Go(func() {
+				panic("super badder thing")
+			})
+			p := wg.WaitAndRecover()
+			require.NotNil(t, p)
+		})
+
+		t.Run("nonpanics run successfully with waitandrecover", func(t *testing.T) {
+			t.Parallel()
+			var wg WaitGroup
+			var i atomic.Int64
+			wg.Go(func() {
+				i.Add(1)
+			})
+			wg.Go(func() {
+				panic("super bad thing")
+			})
+			wg.Go(func() {
+				i.Add(1)
+			})
+			p := wg.WaitAndRecover()
+			require.Equal(t, p.Value, "super bad thing")
+			require.Equal(t, int64(2), i.Load())
+		})
 	})
 }

explanation.what: WaitGroup に WaitAndRecover() メソッドを追加した。既存の Wait() は子 goroutine の panic を再 panic(Repanic)して伝播させるのに対し、WaitAndRecover() はブロックして全 goroutine の完了を待ったのち、panic を再送せずに *panics.RecoveredPanic として返す。waitgroup_test.go にも panic 捕捉・複数 panic・panic と正常終了の混在を確認するテストが追加された。
explanation.why: issue #29 で「Wait() は panic を再 panic するしかなく、呼び出し側が手動で recover() すると RecoveredPanic の型情報が失われる。panic を捕まえて呼び出し側に返す WaitSafe 相当のメソッドが欲しい」という要望があり、それに応える形でこの PR が作られた。PR 本文でも issue #29 の解決を明記している。

highlights.note: WaitAndRecover は Wait と違い h.pc.Repanic() ではなく h.pc.Recovered() を呼び、panic を再送せず値として返す

langNotes.note: Go には例外機構がなく、panic/recover で異常系を扱う。conc の panics.Catcher はこの recover をカプセル化し、WaitAndRecover() のように「panic を再送せず戻り値として受け取る」API を提供することで、呼び出し側が型情報(RecoveredPanic)を保ったままハンドリングできるようにしている。
